title: Use Bikeshed’s algorithm construct.
body:
This PR: - marks up all algorithms with `
`, - gives a name to those which don't include a ``, - ~~turns single step algorithms (e.g. `return false`) to prose.~~ - Fix algorithms that generated Bikeshed warnings (due to missing variables or mistakes in variable names). This PR is too big to be apprehended as a whole in GitHub, however it's split into explicitly named commits. The first commit is just a markup change, as shown by its [HTML diff](https://services.w3.org/htmldiff?doc1=https%3A%2F%2Fheycam.github.io%2Fwebidl%2F&doc2=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.rawgit.com%2Ftobie%2Fwebidl%2Fb6b4453%2Findex.html). Every following commit is atomic and addresses a particular issue raised by Bikeshed.
